svg.title: Validation loss and learning rate
svg.desc: Two panels sharing the training-token axis. Top: validation loss falls from 3.579 to 2.998 across 3 phases. Each restart pushes it back above the previous phase's final loss; the shaded wedges show those debts, costing 600, 1100 steps. Bottom: the learning rate, decayed and restarted once per phase.
